statement: Publish a testable v1 loopback manual-run console contract for Vibez and Homebase.
acceptanceCriteria: MR-001.1: Validate versioned good and bad examples for waiting, blocked, disconnected/last-observed, accepted/reused/rejected, validation failure, rework and completion. Separate receipt, gate and host actions.
MR-001.2: Preserve exact original Markdown and stable project/session/attempt/packet, role, revision and receipt references across reads, with explicit historical-body and PR/CI unknown states.

MR-001.3: Define scoping, versions, limits, session setup, polling, retries and uncertain outcomes. Provide independently consumable conformance inputs and pinning and compatibility/rollback guidance.
